method: Static source analysis, Cleave facts including decoded strings and flow, Rizin control-flow disassembly, PE resource extraction and independent RC4 decryption. Samples were never executed. ML scores and trait names were not behavioral proof.

evidence: Complete 292-byte source: update() reads the GitHub response text as a URL authority, fetches http://${gateway}/codepy, reads its body and passes that same source variable to eval.
Module evaluation invokes update() immediately and registers it with setInterval(...,3600000), giving an hourly repeat. No payload authentication or user approval is present.
Source is unobfuscated; no hidden decoded script was present. The filename suggests host resolution, whereas the resulting behavior is recurring arbitrary remote code execution.
samples.judgment: MALICIOUS: reusable external code evaluation through mutable host indirection, immediately and on a timer, establishes an unattended control channel. No enclosing application, authorized deployment or package provenance was supplied.
samples.marker_line: Host resolver: dead-drop code evaluation repeats hourly

samples.identification: Python sitecustomize startup credential stealer and remote-code daemon; privcollect-associated indicators
evidence: collect() reads eight home-relative credential stores: AWS, Kubernetes, npm, PyPI, Git, netrc and RSA/Ed25519 SSH private keys. A second loop reads /proc/*/environ; inaccessible entries are skipped. Contents are accumulated in the same secrets dictionary.

The dictionary is JSON-serialized and gzip-compressed, padded and encrypted with a random 32-byte AES key in CBC mode with a random 16-byte IV. RSA-OAEP encrypts the AES key with the embedded public key. requests.post sends wrapped key + IV + ciphertext to http://www.litellm.dev/healthcheck with X-Token and binary content-type headers. Only a successful HTTP status causes the hidden one-shot marker to be touched.

Module code starts collection in a daemon thread, then forks. The child calls setsid(), chdir(/), redirects descriptors 0/1/2 to /dev/null, and calls poll(). A nonblocking exclusive flock limits concurrent pollers.

poll() obtains the next host from the same GitHub domain.txt used by the JavaScript sample, fetches /codepy and directly execs the returned Python text in an infinite loop, sleeping 3600 seconds between iterations. Network/exec errors are not retried by an outer exception handler.
The interpreter-mandated sitecustomize.py name is a startup activation surface when installed on Python's import path. The provided standalone file does not establish where it was installed.
samples.judgment: MALICIOUS: silent collection and encrypted export of unrelated credential stores and cross-process environments, coupled to startup activation and a detached remote-code executor. Exact original distribution, package version, successful upload and runtime deployment were not established.
changes: Extend the existing procfs glob selector to recognize */environ as well as [0-9]*/environ.

Add a neutral, source-bound detection connecting credential path iteration, reads into a dictionary, JSON/gzip serialization, encryption and the actual POST body; it rejects unrelated dictionaries, reads, sent bodies and intervening overwrites.

Reference that bound transfer from the existing hostile Python credential HTTP-upload objective. The generic engine file-to-HTTP event did not preserve the credential type for tuple-joined home paths.

evidence: CRT entry 0x4139a4 invokes main at 0x408d1f. Main calls 0x409832, which obtains RCDATA SETTINGS through 0x409cbd. The first resource byte is 128, followed by a 128-byte key and 267 encrypted bytes. KSA at 0x402f31 and PRGA at 0x402f8b implement RC4 with DWORD state, modulo-256 swaps and a bytewise output XOR. Independent RC4 decoding recovered a coherent 55-field configuration.

Decoded configuration contains controller 185.140.53.140:2404, controller password pass, agent name Talentino, install filename remcos.exe, mutex Remcos-KG5D4I, log filename logs.dat, and screenshot/audio directory names. These are evidence only; no new matcher depends on them.

0x405145 passes global thread ID zero, callback 0x40512a and WH_KEYBOARD_LL=13 to imported SetWindowsHookExA. The callback forwards to 0x40519d, which processes keyboard events and key state. 0x405359 stages recorded text into local/online buffers according to flags.

Clipboard acquisition at 0x406a29 opens the clipboard, obtains clipboard data and locks it. 0x406a6f compares successive text, wraps changed content with copied-clipboard recording text and passes it to the same recording routine 0x405359.

UAC hijack routine 0x403067 checks Windows build, saves the existing mscfile command, writes its executable path to HKCU Software\Classes\mscfile\shell\open\command through 0x40b632 (RegCreateKeyW/RegSetValueExW), then ShellExecuteW launches eventvwr.exe hidden. Main and a command-dispatch path reference this routine.

0x40a09c launches cmd.exe with a reg.exe command setting HKLM Policies\System EnableLUA=0, using CREATE_NO_WINDOW. This is a present policy-disable capability; success or activation in the supplied state was not observed.

Hollowing routine 0x40f078 checks MZ/PE headers, resolves NtUnmapViewOfSection, creates a child with CREATE_SUSPENDED=4, gets thread context and PEB image base, unmaps an overlapping host image, allocates RWX remote memory, writes PE headers and sections, patches PEB.ImageBaseAddress and saved entrypoint, sets thread context and resumes the child.

Winsock receive paths 0x402149 and 0x4033ee consume socket input; the agent includes controller file-transfer and execution dispatch. Browser-data deletion is real code: 0x406f49 builds the Chrome Login Data path and calls DeleteFileA; its status follows the API result, and 0x407860 invokes it from the broader browser-clear routine.
The file contains relocated/resolved-looking IAT data and initialized runtime state. Static code establishes capabilities, not that every configuration-gated operation executed in the supplied state.
samples.judgment: MALICIOUS: configured remote agent with covert keyboard/clipboard recording, process hollowing and elevation-control bypass. Remcos can be used for legitimate administration, but these concealment and surveillance paths tip the judgment absent evidence of an authorized deployment. The referenced sandbox page was inaccessible and its score was not used as behavioral proof.

verification.focused_controls: check.py: 19 static positive and negative controls passed, including renamed variables, httpx, old and new procfs globs, public files, changed roots, overwritten data, unrelated reads/dictionaries/bodies, quoted code, WH_MOUSE_LL and an existing benign PE fixture.
limitations: No archives or fetched dependency members were present in any of the three scan reports.
Atomscan reports older v18 feature specifications relative to v19 extraction. All final ML verdicts remain HOSTILE; no observed classifier miss resulted.

The generic payload-flow producer retains only a file-http-body event for this Python collector, losing the tuple-derived credential type; the new bound trait fills that detection gap without altering the engine.
